schema_version.description: Schema version; this build reads version 1.

accent.description: Accent colour token used by the apps.

ticket_pattern.description: Regular expression that recognises ticket numbers such as `WEB-142`.

ticket_url.description: URL template for a ticket; `{ticket}` is replaced by the number.

hosts.description: Hosts this workspace's links point at.

browser.description: Browser to open links with; `None` means the system default.

hours_per_day.description: Working hours in a day, used by the day plan; above 0 and at most 24.

log_folder.description: Folder that holds the day logs, relative to the workspace root.

story_template.description: Template note for new stories, relative to the workspace root.

billing.description: How the workspace bills its time; `None` until a model is picked.

log_deadline.description:
When the week's hours must be logged by; the week close-out runs only
for a workspace with one.

leave_source.description:
The name of the workspace whose `Leave.md` lists leave and public
holidays; the life workspace when absent.

features.description:
Per-feature settings, keyed by feature id. Opaque in the base version;
each feature validates its own entry against its settings schema.

title: Vaultday workspace settings
description: The manifest at .vaultday/settings.json that marks a folder as a Vaultday workspace. Unknown keys are preserved. The keys security, tokens, rates, models and integrations are refused at every depth and without case, as is any key that names a secret (token, password, api_key, ...); the reader enforces this, the schema can only state the top-level rule.

oneOf.description: A client workspace; two of these may not nest.

WorkspaceKind.description: Whether a workspace holds client work or the user's own life.

rounding_minutes.description: Hourly only: the increment billable time rounds up to, 1 to 60 minutes; 15 when absent.

billable_default.description: Hourly only: whether a task is billable until marked otherwise; true when absent.

flat_hours.description:
FTE only: hours of the flat Toggl entry per working day, above 0 and
at most 24; 8 when absent. Logged time uses `hours_per_day`.

BillingSettings.description:
The `billing` block of `settings.json`. Each model reads only its own
keys; a key of another model is refused so a switch never leaves a stale
value behind. Unknown keys are kept.

oneOf.description: Sessions are billable time, rounded up to the workspace increment.
Each task's estimate is its quote and cap; an overrun is unpaid.
Full-time equivalent: tracked time stays private; a flat day goes out.

BillingModel.description:
How a workspace bills its time. Rates and currencies are not here: they
live in the signed app-level document only.

time.description: The time of day, `HH:MM` in 24 hours.

LogDeadline.description:
When a week's hours must be logged by: the first `weekday` at or after
the week's Friday, at `time`. The week close-out runs for a workspace
that has one.

SettingsWeekday.description: A day of the week, as `log_deadline` names it.

propertyNames.description: The forbidden keys, compared without case.
